title: iOS Developer

nodes.title: Swift Language Fundamentals & Type System
nodes.subtitle: Optionals, optional binding, guard, value types (structs) vs reference types (classes)
learning_objectives: Leverage Swift optionals and guard statements to write crash-free code
Choose appropriately between value types (structs) and reference types (classes)
feynman_prompts: Why does Swift prefer structs (value semantics) over classes (reference semantics) for data models?
key_misconceptions: Force-unwrapping optionals with ! instead of using if-let or guard-let

nodes.title: Protocols & Protocol-Oriented Programming
nodes.subtitle: Protocols, protocol extensions, associated types, generics, type constraints
learning_objectives: Design flexible architectures using Protocol-Oriented Programming (POP)
Implement generic algorithms and reusable data structures with type constraints
feynman_prompts: How does Protocol-Oriented Programming differ from traditional single-inheritance OOP?
key_misconceptions: Using heavy class inheritance hierarchies instead of composable protocols

nodes.title: Memory Management & ARC Mechanics
nodes.subtitle: Automatic Reference Counting (ARC), strong, weak, and unowned references, retain cycles
learning_objectives: Identify and eliminate retain cycles between closures and view controllers
Use [weak self] capture lists safely to prevent memory leaks
feynman_prompts: Explain how a retain cycle occurs when a closure captures self strongly.
key_misconceptions: Using [unowned self] when an object can outlive the closure, causing runtime memory crashes

nodes.title: SwiftUI: Declarative UI & Layout System
nodes.subtitle: Views, modifiers, VStack, HStack, ZStack, List, LazyVStack, view composition
learning_objectives: Build modern declarative user interfaces using SwiftUI view hierarchies
Design performant scrollable lists using List and LazyVStack
feynman_prompts: How does SwiftUI declarative view rendering differ from imperative UIKit layout?
key_misconceptions: Building monolithic 500-line body properties instead of decomposing into small reusable subviews

nodes.title: SwiftUI State & Observation Framework
nodes.subtitle: @State, @Binding, @Observable, @Environment, unidirectional data flow
learning_objectives: Manage local and shared reactive state using the modern @Observable macro
Pass read-write state bindings down view hierarchies with @Binding
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between @State (local view ownership) and @Binding (two-way reference)?
key_misconceptions: Creating global singletons for view-specific transient state

nodes.title: Navigation & Deep Linking with NavigationStack
nodes.subtitle: NavigationStack, navigationDestination, path binding, deep linking
learning_objectives: Implement programmatic navigation using NavigationPath and type-safe destinations
Handle universal deep links to route directly into specific view destinations
feynman_prompts: How does NavigationPath enable programmatic multi-step pop and push transitions?
key_misconceptions: Relying on deprecated NavigationView instead of modern NavigationStack

nodes.title: Modern Swift Concurrency: async/await & Actors
nodes.subtitle: async/await, Task, TaskGroup, MainActor, thread-safe data isolation with Actors
learning_objectives: Write structured asynchronous code using modern Swift async/await
Protect mutable state against data races using Actors and MainActor
feynman_prompts: Why does Swift compile-time actor isolation eliminate race conditions without manual mutex locks?
key_misconceptions: Executing heavy background data processing on @MainActor, freezing the UI

nodes.title: Networking: URLSession & Codable Serialization
nodes.subtitle: URLSession, Codable, Decodable, async data fetching, error handling
learning_objectives: Fetch remote API data asynchronously using URLSession and modern async/await
Deserialize nested JSON responses into strongly-typed Swift models using Decodable
feynman_prompts: How does the Codable protocol automate JSON parsing with compile-time type safety?
key_misconceptions: Parsing raw JSON dictionaries manually without type-safe Codable models

nodes.title: Local Persistence: SwiftData & Core Data
nodes.subtitle: SwiftData @Model, ModelContext, queries with @Query, relationships, migrations
learning_objectives: Persist structured application data offline using the modern SwiftData framework
Define model relationships and perform efficient predicate queries with @Query
feynman_prompts: How does SwiftData leverage Swift macros to simplify schema definitions compared to legacy Core Data?
key_misconceptions: Mutating ModelContext data on background threads without proper actor isolation

nodes.title: UIKit Interoperability in SwiftUI
nodes.subtitle: UIViewRepresentable, UIViewControllerRepresentable, Coordinator pattern
learning_objectives: Bridge legacy UIKit components into modern SwiftUI view hierarchies
Manage delegate callbacks and two-way communication using Coordinators
feynman_prompts: Why is the Coordinator pattern necessary when wrapping UIKit views with delegates in SwiftUI?
key_misconceptions: Re-creating expensive UIKit view instances on every SwiftUI body re-evaluation

nodes.title: iOS Architecture: MVVM & Clean Architecture
nodes.subtitle: MVVM pattern, view models, domain interactor use cases, repository abstractions
learning_objectives: Decouple UI views from business logic and data sources using MVVM
Write testable view models with mocked repository protocols
feynman_prompts: Why should SwiftUI Views contain zero networking or database persistence logic?
key_misconceptions: Making direct network URLSession requests inside SwiftUI view body computed properties

nodes.title: Automated Testing: XCTest & View Model Verification
nodes.subtitle: XCTestCase, expectation, mocking protocols, testing async code, code coverage
learning_objectives: Write deterministic unit tests for business logic and ViewModels using XCTest
Test asynchronous methods safely using expectation(description:) and async testing
feynman_prompts: Why is protocol-based dependency injection essential for mocking dependencies in XCTest?
key_misconceptions: Writing unit tests that depend on real live network responses, leading to flaky CI runs

nodes.title: UI Testing & Accessibility Auditing
nodes.subtitle: XCUIApplication, accessibilityIdentifier, UI assertions, automated user flows
learning_objectives: Automate user journey testing across screens using XCUIApplication
Assign accessibilityIdentifiers to enable reliable UI element querying
feynman_prompts: Why are accessibilityIdentifiers superior to localized UI text for automated UI testing?
key_misconceptions: Querying UI test elements by user-visible text that breaks when localizing into other languages

nodes.title: Performance Optimization with Instruments
nodes.subtitle: Xcode Instruments, Time Profiler, Allocations, Leaks, view body churn
learning_objectives: Identify CPU bottlenecks and main thread hangs using Xcode Time Profiler
Pinpoint memory retain cycles and allocation leaks using the Leaks instrument
feynman_prompts: How do you identify which SwiftUI views are undergoing unnecessary re-evaluation churn?
key_misconceptions: Assuming that code running smoothly in the Xcode Simulator will run at 60/120fps on physical devices

nodes.title: iOS Security & Keychain Services
nodes.subtitle: Keychain Services, LocalAuthentication (Face ID / Touch ID), certificate pinning
learning_objectives: Store sensitive user tokens and private credentials securely in the iOS Keychain
Protect app access using biometric Face ID / Touch ID authentication
feynman_prompts: Why is UserDefaults insecure for storing auth tokens, and why is Keychain required?
key_misconceptions: Storing auth tokens and API keys in plain text inside UserDefaults

nodes.title: App Extensions & WidgetKit
nodes.subtitle: WidgetKit, TimelineProvider, dynamic widgets, App Groups for shared data
learning_objectives: Build glanceable iOS Home Screen widgets using WidgetKit and TimelineProvider
Share data between the main app and widget extensions using App Groups
feynman_prompts: How does TimelineProvider schedule widget updates without running continuously in the background?
key_misconceptions: Attempting to execute network calls directly in widget view rendering instead of the timeline provider

nodes.title: Swift Package Manager & Modular Architecture
nodes.subtitle: Swift Package Manager (SPM), multi-package architecture, build time reduction
learning_objectives: Decompose monolithic iOS applications into lightweight Swift Packages
Enforce strict module boundaries and dramatically improve incremental build times
feynman_prompts: What are the modularity benefits of managing local feature modules via Swift Package Manager?
key_misconceptions: Creating circular dependencies between Swift Packages

nodes.title: CI/CD & App Store Distribution
nodes.subtitle: Fastlane, TestFlight distribution, App Store Connect, signing certificates & provisioning
learning_objectives: Automate build signing and TestFlight deployment using Fastlane pipelines
Configure App Store metadata, screenshots, and privacy nutrition labels
feynman_prompts: Why is automated code signing (Fastlane Match) critical when collaborating on iOS teams?
key_misconceptions: Manually managing development provisioning profiles on individual team laptops

description: Master iOS Developer with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
